rationale: Authentication was correctly performed via email lookup and all actions targeted the authenticated user’s orders. The agent correctly verified item availability and obtained explicit confirmation (including price impact) before modifying the makeup kit. However, two policy violations occurred: (1) The agent updated the shipping address for #W5056519 without first restating the exact new address and obtaining explicit confirmation; (2) The agent cancelled order #W5995614 immediately after viewing details, without restating and confirming the cancellation action. Additionally, the refund timeline (5–7 business days) was asserted without tool support. Because the policy requires explicit user confirmation before any order-changing write, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
